label: Research Problem
definition: The central problem or question that motivates the inquiry.

label: Core Concepts
definition: The key ideas required to understand and frame the study.

label: Assumptions
definition: The premises that shape interpretation and model boundaries.

label: Relationships
definition: The named connections among concepts constructs variables or mechanisms.

label: Evidence
definition: The source material data observations or documents used to support claims.

label: Methods
definition: The procedures used to collect interpret analyze or model evidence.

label: Interpretation
definition: The meaning assigned to evidence through the framework.

label: Revision
definition: The process of updating the framework as evidence and understanding develop.

label: Boundary Conditions
definition: The conditions under which the framework applies.

label: Mechanisms
definition: The processes that explain how or why relationships occur.
